title: No netherite
description: Completely removes netherite armor, weapons and tools
body:
No Netherite (Datapack)
This datapack completely removes Netherite from Minecraft. All Netherite armor, tools, and weapons are disabled—crafting, upgrading, or obtaining them in survival is impossible. Diamond once again becomes the strongest tier of equipment.

Perfect for:

Players who want a classic endgame experience

Servers seeking more balanced PvP and survival progression

Worlds where Netherite is considered too powerful or immersion-breaking


✅️ Removes Netherite armor, weapons, and tools.

✅️ Works in survival and multiplayer.

✅️ Lightweight and easy to install.
